{{Quote|At Muunilinst, a three-way fleet battle rages among forces loyal to Head of State Fel and Moffs Woolbam and Callron the Younger.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
The '''Muunilinst system''' was a 6-orbit system that contained the planet of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="GatORW" />

In [[44 ABY]], during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], the Muunilinst system was the site of a [[Battle of Muunilinst (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|three-way fleet battle]] between [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] forces loyal to [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] and treacherous [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Woolbam]] and [[Callron]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
